title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Hardened Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec (6,2) STNFS (de Bruijn + Hard-Cap Z[omega] LA): 2^87.372777743

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal CM-sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, Arch B-Hybrid reversed a-table super-bucket replay with pure-scalar 64-bit SWAR scan+zero, full de Bruijn local-density correction rho_dB, B_f = 2^60, B_g = 2^59, excess 0.95, 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann with deterministic hard-cap abort and hard-cap cost/RAM pricing at (N_sw_cap, N_l_cap) = 1.75x direct 8-seed U'=2^21 (mean + 2 SE), and live 62-row 12D descent at B_g = 2^59) returns (P0, [x]Q0) with e(P0, [x]Q0) = z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^88.686577254 <= 2^87.372777743 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under declared heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 7, explicitly including H3 that production filtered dimensions stay within (N_sw_cap, N_l_cap) with failure <= 0.027819, and H5's standard STNFS Poisson/PGF relation-count envelope, conditional candidate independence psi^k, and uniform <= 1/(li(2^59)/6) tau-orbit collision law). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7420388798548898458, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.969522 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.969522 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U) with conservative single-side tau-orbit count li(2^59)/6 (RT). All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
